one_sentence: Svensson (1994), NBER Working Paper No. 4871 (also issued as IMF Working Paper 94/114), fits an extended Nelson-Siegel forward-rate curve to Swedish data from 1992-1994 and shows how the resulting forward rates can be read as market expectations of future interest rates, inflation, and currency depreciation.

issues.reason: This is an NBER working paper, not a peer-reviewed journal article. NBER Working Paper 4871 was never published in a journal under this title (it has a parallel institutional working-paper release, IMF WP/94/114, but neither is a journal). BibTeX's @techreport (institution/type/number) is the correct entry type for a research-institute working paper.

issues.corrected: (removed; use institution={National Bureau of Economic Research} and type={NBER Working Paper} instead, under @techreport)
issues.reason: NBER is the issuing institution, not a journal — it does not publish a periodical called 'National Bureau of Economic Research'. Putting the institution's name in the journal field is a category error that misrepresents the work as a refereed journal article.

Confirmed correct working paper number (the 'w' is NBER's URL/filename prefix, not part of the citable number; NBER's own citation guidance and RePEc list it as No. 4871). Kept the digits, dropped the letter prefix for citation-style consistency; either form is defensible but the digits were already right, so no substantive correction was needed here beyond formatting.
Verified against the NBER landing page (nber.org/papers/w4871): publication date is September 1994. The year field was already correct.

issues.original: title={Estimating and interpreting forward interest rates: Sweden 1992-1994}
issues.corrected: title={Estimating and Interpreting Forward Interest Rates: Sweden 1992--1994}
issues.reason: The title text and year range (1992-1994, not 1992-1992 or 1992-1993) were already correct, verified against the NBER landing page and the paper's own PDF header. Only capitalization (title case, matching NBER's official listing) and the en-dash-as-double-hyphen convention for the year range were adjusted; this is a minor hygiene fix, not a factual correction.

The author's initials 'EO' are run together without periods or a space. NBER and IMF both list the author as 'Lars E. O. Svensson'. BibTeX needs 'Lars E. O.' (with spaces/periods between initials) so the name parses as three given-name tokens instead of one; 'Lars EO' risks being rendered as a single garbled initial block by some .bst styles.
No DOI was present. NBER assigns DOI 10.3386/w4871 to this working paper; adding it gives a durable, resolvable canonical anchor independent of URL changes.
No URL was present. The NBER landing page is the canonical anchor for this working paper and should be included per BibTeX hygiene for grey-literature/working-paper entries.

issues.corrected: note={Also issued as IMF Working Paper No. 94/114, September 1994}
issues.reason: This NBER working paper has a parallel contemporaneous release as an IMF Working Paper, same title and month/year: IMF WP/1994/114 (confirmed via IMF eLibrary at elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/001/1994/114/001.1994.issue-114-en.xml and RePEc ideas.repec.org/p/imf/imfwpa/1994-114.html). Worth recording since some downstream citations of this Svensson (1994) piece cite the IMF version instead of NBER w4871. Not required for a valid @techreport entry, but flagged as requested; the IMF version's own DOI was not independently confirmed and is intentionally omitted here.
